fields.meta_description: Looking for {focus_keyword} in {location}, Kenya? Greenafrica Agri Solutions delivers expert {service_category} across {location} and major Kenyan cities. Call {phone_1} today.

article_structure.instructions: Write 2-3 paragraphs introducing the topic. Include the focus keyword naturally in the first sentence. Mention the company name, its Westlands Nairobi headquarters, and 2-3 target locations. End with a CTA including the phone number. Keep each paragraph under 200 words.
article_structure.cta: Call {phone_1} today for a free consultation.

article_structure.instructions: Write 2-3 paragraphs on the relevance of this topic in Kenya's current economic and environmental landscape. Reference at least 2 Kenyan cities from the target_locations list. Use at least 3 transition words. Include 1 LSI keyword from the lsi_keyword_bank. Keep each paragraph under 200 words.

article_structure.heading_text: Our Services: {service_category} and More Across Kenya
article_structure.instructions: This section must contain exactly 7 H3 subheadings. Each H3 covers one service from service_categories. For each service, write 2-3 short paragraphs (each under 200 words). Reference a different Kenyan city in each H3 block. Use transition words between paragraphs. At least one H3 must mention the primary focus keyword.

article_structure.heading_text: Greenafrica Agri Solutions: Serving Major Cities Across Kenya
article_structure.instructions: Write one short paragraph (3-5 sentences) per city. Cover at least 6 cities from target_locations. For each city, mention a specific service or local context relevant to that city. Avoid bullet points — write in flowing prose. Insert the internal link to the services page at least once in this section.

article_structure.heading_text: Why Choose Greenafrica Agri Solutions for {focus_keyword}?
article_structure.instructions: Write 4-5 short paragraphs, each highlighting one unique selling point: local expertise, multidisciplinary team, transparent pricing, sustainable approach, proven track record. Each paragraph must be under 200 words. Use transition words to connect paragraphs. Include the internal link to the About page once.

article_structure.heading_text: How to Get Started with {focus_keyword} in {location}
article_structure.instructions: Write 1-2 paragraphs explaining the simple steps to engage Greenafrica. Include the phone number, email, physical address, and business hours. Add internal links to the Contact and Services pages. End with a strong CTA.

article_structure.heading_text: Frequently Asked Questions About {focus_keyword} in Kenya
article_structure.instructions: Generate exactly 5 FAQ pairs. Each question must be answerable in 2-5 sentences. Questions should naturally include the focus keyword, location, or related LSI keywords. Answers must be concise, factual, and include at least one mention of Greenafrica Agri Solutions.
Write 1 short closing paragraph (3-5 sentences) reinforcing the CTA. Include the company name, focus keyword, primary location, phone number, and a link to the contact page. Keep it under 100 words.

sections.content: string — full HTML or plain text body for this section

fields.internal_links_used: array of strings — URLs used in the article

system_prompt: You are an expert SEO content writer for Greenafrica Agri Solutions (https://greenafrica.co.ke), a professional agri-solutions, construction, and consulting company based in Westlands, Nairobi, Kenya. Your job is to write fully SEO-optimized blog articles strictly following the provided template structure. Always output valid JSON matching the output_format schema. Never add sections not in the template. Always include the company contact details where instructed. Always use at least 4 internal links from the internal_links object. Always target the provided focus_keyword and location. Keep word count between 1000 and 1500 words. Use transition words for at least 30% of sentences. Write 75% of sentences under 20 words. Never exceed 200 words per paragraph.
